predictive-maintenance-system.background: A machine learning capstone project for the Nalar Data Science & Analyst Bootcamp, built with Python (regression and classification) and taken through to deployment.
predictive-maintenance-system.problem:
Factories want to prevent downtime and reduce maintenance cost.

The question behind this project: can machine failure be predicted **before breakdown**?
objectives: Help factories prevent downtime and reduce maintenance cost
predictive-maintenance-system.role: Built a machine learning system to predict machine failure before breakdown, and applied the full data science pipeline: EDA, preprocessing, model building, and deployment.

process.title: Model building
process.text: Regression and classification models in Python.

predictive-maintenance-system.outcome: A machine learning system that predicts machine failure before breakdown, taken through to deployment as the capstone deliverable.

crustea-order-fulfillment-automation.background: Crustea is an Indonesian smart aquaculture startup. The project was carried out as a team project at BINUS University.
crustea-order-fulfillment-automation.problem: Crustea handled order fulfillment through a **fully manual process**.
objectives: Map the existing manual order fulfillment process
Design a structured workflow to automate it
crustea-order-fulfillment-automation.role: A 4-person team project. The team interviewed Crustea's operations and sales team to map the manual order fulfillment process, then designed a 6-phase, 21-node n8n workflow.

process.title: Understanding the business process
process.text: Interviews with Crustea's operations and sales team to map the fully manual order fulfillment process.

process.title: Designing the workflow
process.text: A 6-phase, 21-node n8n workflow covering validation, stock check, quotation, scheduling, logistics, and customer notification.

crustea-order-fulfillment-automation.outcome: A designed n8n workflow that covers order fulfillment from validation through to customer notification.

results.label: Workflow phases
results.text: Validation, stock check, quotation, scheduling, logistics, and customer notification.

customer-repeat-purchase-prediction.background: An analysis of a 10,000-row customer dataset for a retail use case, carried out in RapidMiner / Altair AI Studio.
customer-repeat-purchase-prediction.problem: A retail use case: can **repeat purchase behavior** be predicted from customer data?
objectives: Compare Decision Tree, Naive Bayes, and Linear Regression models
customer-repeat-purchase-prediction.role: Individual project. Analyzed the dataset, handled preprocessing including nominal and numeric type conversion, built and compared the models, and applied K-Means clustering for customer segmentation.

process.title: Preprocessing
process.text: Including nominal and numeric type conversion.

process.title: Model building and comparison
process.text: Decision Tree, Naive Bayes, and Linear Regression.

customer-repeat-purchase-prediction.outcome: The best-performing model reached 80–90% accuracy, and K-Means clustering was applied for customer segmentation.

ai-integrated-learning-student-innovatio.background: An explanatory sequential mixed-methods study, analyzed with PLS-SEM in SmartPLS.
ai-integrated-learning-student-innovatio.problem: How does **AI-integrated learning** shape students' readiness for innovation?
objectives: Investigate how AI-integrated learning shapes student readiness for innovation
ai-integrated-learning-student-innovatio.role: A four-person research team. The team investigated the research question, simplified the original model after identifying discriminant validity issues, and prepared the manuscript to MDPI Systems journal submission standards.

process.title: Model analysis
process.text: PLS-SEM in SmartPLS. An original 5-construct mediation model was simplified to a 2-predictor direct-effects model after discriminant validity issues were identified.

process.title: Manuscript
process.text: Prepared to MDPI Systems journal submission standards.

ai-integrated-learning-student-innovatio.outcome: Both hypotheses of the simplified model were supported.

results.label: Explained variance in the final model

ai-integrated-learning-student-innovatio.reflection: The original model had five constructs and a mediation structure. Discriminant validity issues showed up in the analysis, so the model was simplified to two predictors with direct effects. Both resulting hypotheses were supported.
